question: Which field can be used to override the name of a dashboard displayed to end users without changing the dashboard's internal name?

options.A: Text 1

explanation: D is correct: the Description field displays a user-friendly name to end users without changing the internal Name used for code references. A is incorrect — Text 1 is a general-purpose field. B is incorrect — Notes is for internal documentation. C is incorrect — Tool Tip displays text on hover, not the primary displayed name.

question: Which two visibility settings can be used in a dashboard profile to make a dashboard visible in OnePlace? (Select 2.)

options.A: OnePlace

explanation: A and C are correct: OnePlace makes the dashboard visible specifically in OnePlace, and Always makes it visible in all contexts including OnePlace. B is incorrect — Workflow makes it visible within Workflow navigation only. D is incorrect — Never hides the dashboard from all end users.

question: What are two ways to deploy a dashboard to end users in OneStream? (Select 2.)

options.A: Adding a dashboard to a Workflow Profile step with correct visibility settings.
options.B: Adding a dashboard group to a Workflow Profile step with correct visibility settings.
options.C: Adding a dashboard to a dashboard profile with correct visibility settings.
options.D: Adding a dashboard group to a dashboard profile with correct visibility settings.

explanation: A and D are correct: a dashboard can be deployed by attaching it to a Workflow Profile step (for workflow access) or by adding a dashboard group to a dashboard profile (for OnePlace access). B is incorrect — it is the individual dashboard, not the group, that attaches to a Workflow Profile step. C is incorrect — it is a dashboard group, not an individual dashboard, that is added to a dashboard profile.

question: What is the Data Entry 123 MarketPlace solution used for in OneStream?

options.A: To define connections to external financial data sources.
options.B: To simplify the creation of forms used within the application.
options.C: To monitor and optimize OneStream environments.
options.D: To create dynamic and stored calculations for dimension members.

explanation: B is correct: Data Entry 123 simplifies the creation of data entry forms. A is incorrect — external data connections use data integration connectors. C is incorrect — that describes System Diagnostics. D is incorrect — calculations use Member Formulas and business rules.

question: What is the System Diagnostics MarketPlace solution used for in OneStream?

options.A: To simplify the creation of forms used within the application.
options.C: To monitor and optimize OneStream environments, providing live insights into application and database server performance.
options.D: To view and compare business rules created in the application.

explanation: C is correct: System Diagnostics provides live insights into application and database server performance for monitoring and optimization. A is incorrect — that describes Data Entry 123. B is incorrect — Security Roles are maintained through system settings. D is incorrect — business rule comparison is a separate function.

question: What is the HelpDesk MarketPlace solution used for in OneStream?

options.A: Scheduling tasks and data management sequences.
options.B: Managing end-user issues and requests through a support ticket-based system.
options.C: Real-time problem solving through a live chat feature.
options.D: Simplifying the management of Cube Views and dashboards.

explanation: B is correct: HelpDesk manages end-user issues through a ticket-based system. A is incorrect — task scheduling uses data management sequences. C is incorrect — HelpDesk uses tickets, not live chat. D is incorrect — Cube View management is done through the application administration features.

question: What is the Standard Application Reports MarketPlace solution used for?

options.A: To provide detailed insights into workflow, dimensions, formulas, and more through pre-built reports.
options.B: To visualize the Calculation Status of financial data.
options.C: To monitor and optimize OneStream environments.
options.D: To simplify the creation of forms used within the application.

explanation: A is correct: Standard Application Reports offers over seventy pre-built reports on workflow statuses, certification, journals, commentary, and metadata changes. B is incorrect — Calculation Status is shown via CalcStatus view member. C is incorrect — that describes System Diagnostics. D is incorrect — that describes Data Entry 123.

question: What is a method query in OneStream?

options.A: A tool for setting up and configuring data connectors to non-financial sources.
options.B: A batch processing tool for large data uploads.
options.C: A type of query that utilizes predefined scripts to fetch or manipulate data within the application.
options.D: A diagnostic tool for troubleshooting performance issues.

explanation: C is correct: a method query uses predefined scripts to fetch or manipulate data within OneStream — referencing business rules, application reports, and other internal scripts. A is incorrect — data connectors are configured in Data Integration. B is incorrect — batch processing describes data management sequences. D is incorrect — diagnostic tools describe System Diagnostics.

question: Which database locations can a SQL data adapter query in OneStream?

options.A: Application and framework databases only.

explanation: B is correct: SQL data adapters can query the Application database (cube and stage data), Framework database (system-level information), and external databases (outside OneStream). A is incorrect — external databases are also accessible. C is incorrect — local file systems are not valid targets. D is incorrect — local network drives are not valid targets.

question: Where in a source Cube View should a user specify parameters when setting up links to a target Cube View for data drill-down?

options.A: In the Point of View slider.

explanation: D is correct: Navigation Links in the source Cube View facilitate the transfer of selected dimensions to the POV of the target Cube View for detailed drill-down. A is incorrect — the POV slider sets the source's own POV. B is incorrect — Sharing manages Column Sharing. C is incorrect — Rows and Columns > Default sets expansion behaviors.

question: What is a data management sequence in OneStream?

options.A: A utility for direct editing of database schema.
options.B: A utility for viewing and comparing business rules.
options.C: A scheduling tool for regular data backups.
options.D: A series of steps designed to execute in a specific order to perform various data management tasks.

explanation: D is correct: a data management sequence executes a series of steps in a specific order for tasks like calculations, translations, consolidations, and data exports. A is incorrect — database schema editing is a DBA task. B is incorrect — business rule comparison is a separate feature. C is incorrect — data backups are system administration tasks.

question: A user wants to query workflow statuses within the application. Which MarketPlace solution would they use?

options.A: Administrator Solution Tools

explanation: D is correct: Standard Application Reports provides pre-built reports on workflow statuses, certification, journals, and metadata changes. A is incorrect — AST manages home pages, not workflow status reports. B is incorrect — System Diagnostics monitors server performance. C is incorrect — Data Entry 123 simplifies form creation.

question: What are two examples of Method Types available in a method query data adapter? (Select 2.)

options.A: System Diagnostics

explanation: C and D are correct: Business Rule (executes a VB.NET business rule) and Application Reports (uses a pre-built report as data source) are valid Method Types. A is incorrect — System Diagnostics is a MarketPlace solution, not a Method Type. B is incorrect — Pivot Grid is a dashboard component.

question: What describes a true Software on Software solution when building assets within an Application Workspace?

options.A: It is software developed by external providers integrated into OneStream.
options.B: It refers to how OneStream operates on a single-tenant, multi-instance environment on Azure.
options.C: It refers to building complete solutions using OneStream's platform as the foundation — similar to how MarketPlace solutions are created.
options.D: It integrates maintenance unit assets into a specific OneStream application only.

explanation: C is correct: Software on Software means building complete solutions on top of OneStream's platform, just as MarketPlace solutions are built. A is incorrect — that describes third-party integrations. B is incorrect — that describes OneStream's cloud architecture. D is incorrect — Software on Software is a broader platform capability concept.

question: What is a Linked Cube View in OneStream?

options.A: A feature that allows users to launch a Cube View using the POV from a selected spreadsheet cell.
options.B: A feature that allows users to launch data attachments from a selected Cube View cell.
options.C: A feature that allows users to open a Cube View in a new window.
options.D: A feature that allows users to launch one Cube View from another.

explanation: D is correct: a Linked Cube View launches one Cube View from another for drill-down purposes. A is incorrect — that describes Cube View Connections in the Spreadsheet Add-In. B is incorrect — data attachments describe the Comments/Attachments feature. C is incorrect — opening in a new window is a standard UI option.

question: A user needs to create a data adapter to query User Activity from the Framework database. What type should they use?

options.A: SQL data adapter

explanation: A is correct: SQL data adapters can query Application, Framework, and external databases — User Activity is Framework data. B is incorrect — Method Query uses predefined scripts. C is incorrect — Cube View MD sources financial Cube View data. D is incorrect — Cube View sources financial Cube View data.

question: A user wants to use a MarketPlace solution to take snapshots of application and database servers. Which solution would they use?

options.A: Administrator Solution Tools

explanation: B is correct: System Diagnostics provides live insights and snapshot capabilities for application and database server performance. A is incorrect — AST manages home pages. C is incorrect — Data Entry 123 simplifies forms. D is incorrect — Standard Application Reports generates operational reports.

question: A user wants to create a data management job to perform a Force Consolidation. What is the correct sequence of steps?

options.A: Create a data management group > Create a step with Force Consolidate > Assign the step to the group.
options.B: Create a data management group > Create a sequence > Create a step with Force Consolidate > Assign the step to the group.
options.C: Create a data management sequence > Create a group > Create a step with Force Consolidate > Assign the step to the group.
options.D: Create a data management group > Create a sequence > Create a step with Force Consolidate > Assign the step to the sequence.

explanation: D is correct: the structure is group > sequence > step, where the step is assigned to the sequence. A is incorrect — a sequence is required between the group and step. B is incorrect — the step is assigned to the sequence, not the group. C is incorrect — the group is created before the sequence.

question: A user needs a data adapter to output workflow statuses for a specific Cube Root Workflow Profile. What type should they use?

options.A: SQL data adapter

explanation: B is correct: a Method Query data adapter using the Application Reports method type retrieves workflow statuses for a specific profile. A is incorrect — while SQL can query application data, Method Query is the appropriate choice for workflow status output. C is incorrect — Cube View MD retrieves financial cube data. D is incorrect — Cube View retrieves financial cube data.

question: What is the difference between a ParamHelper and a SolutionHelper business rule in OneStream?

options.A: ParamHelpers offer broader data processing functionalities. SolutionHelpers manage dynamic parameters.
options.B: ParamHelpers manage dynamic parameters. SolutionHelpers facilitate integration of external data.
options.C: ParamHelpers manage dynamic parameters. SolutionHelpers parse incoming data during import events.
options.D: ParamHelpers manage dynamic parameters based on user inputs or conditions. SolutionHelpers offer broader functionalities for data processing and integration across the platform.

explanation: D is correct: ParamHelpers manage dynamic parameters based on user inputs or conditions, while SolutionHelpers offer broader data processing and integration functionalities across the platform. A is incorrect — the roles are reversed. B is incorrect — SolutionHelpers don't specifically handle external data integration. C is incorrect — parsing import data describes Parser rules.

question: What is a wireframe in the context of OneStream dashboard design?

options.A: A detailed graphical representation of data in a dashboard.
options.B: A basic sketch used to design dashboard layouts, outlining component placement for efficient user interaction.
options.C: A data visualization tool used exclusively in financial reporting.
options.D: A programming framework used to develop software applications.

explanation: B is correct: a wireframe is a basic sketch that designs dashboard layouts by outlining component placement before development begins. A is incorrect — wireframes are planning sketches, not functional visualizations. C is incorrect — wireframes are design tools, not reporting tools. D is incorrect — wireframes are a design concept, not a programming framework.

question: What is the primary purpose of a landing page in OneStream?

options.A: To display detailed financial reports and analyses.
options.B: To host external applications and services.
options.C: To manage user permissions and security settings.
options.D: To provide users with a simple, intuitive starting point that guides them to essential content with minimal clicks.

explanation: D is correct: landing pages provide a simple, intuitive starting point guiding users to essential application content with minimal clicks. A is incorrect — detailed reports are in Cube Views and dashboards. B is incorrect — hosting external apps is not the landing page purpose. C is incorrect — user permissions are managed through security administration.

question: Which MarketPlace solution could an administrator use to assign a home page to a specific user?

options.A: Data Entry 123

explanation: D is correct: Administrator Solution Tools (AST) provides the capability to assign home page dashboards to specific users or groups. A is incorrect — Data Entry 123 simplifies form creation. B is incorrect — System Diagnostics monitors performance. C is incorrect — HelpDesk manages support tickets.

question: Which dashboard component should an administrator use to display a video on a landing page?

options.A: Image

explanation: D is correct: the File Viewer component displays a variety of file formats including videos. A is incorrect — Image displays static image files, not videos. B is incorrect — BI Viewer displays data visualizations. C is incorrect — Label displays static text.

question: Which Image File Source Type should be used for a button referencing an image file uploaded to the Files node in a maintenance unit?

options.A: Application Database File

explanation: D is correct: Workspace File is used for images stored in the Files node of a maintenance unit. A is incorrect — Application Database File is for images in the OneStream database. B is incorrect — File Share File is for network file shares. C is incorrect — URL is for external website images.

question: What are Calculated Fields in the BI Designer tool?

options.A: They create new fields and measures by applying formulas to existing data in the data source.
options.B: They are predefined system fields that automatically come with the data source.
options.C: They allow end users to perform mathematical operations on data when viewing a dashboard.
options.D: They are used to calculate Grand Totals in Pivot Grid items.

explanation: A is correct: Calculated Fields in BI Designer create new custom calculations by applying formulas to existing data source fields. B is incorrect — predefined fields come automatically from data adapters. C is incorrect — end-user runtime operations are not what Calculated Fields define. D is incorrect — Grand Totals are Pivot Grid configuration options.

question: A user wants to add a JPEG image to a dashboard. What steps should they take?

options.A: Upload the JPEG to a file in the maintenance unit > Add the file to an Image component > Add the Image component to the dashboard.
options.B: Add the JPEG directly to a File Viewer component > Add the File Viewer to the dashboard.
options.C: Upload the JPEG to a file in the maintenance unit > Add the file to a File Viewer component > Add the File Viewer to the dashboard.
options.D: Paste the image URL directly into the Dashboard layout properties.

explanation: A is correct: upload image to maintenance unit file > add file to Image component > add Image component to dashboard. B is incorrect — JPEG images use the Image component, not File Viewer. C is incorrect — File Viewer is for documents and videos, not JPEGs. D is incorrect — pasting a URL into layout properties is not how images are added.

question: A header toolbar dashboard needs to be embedded across the top of a landing page. Which layout type is commonly used?

options.A: Canvas

explanation: D is correct: Horizontal Stack Panel organizes components horizontally — ideal for horizontal header toolbars. A is incorrect — Canvas is freeform. B is incorrect — Grid is for rows-and-columns structure. C is incorrect — Vertical Stack Panel stacks vertically, the wrong orientation for a horizontal toolbar.

question: Which MarketPlace solution is used to set the home page for a group of users in OneStream?

options.A: Data Entry 123

explanation: B is correct: Administrator Solution Tools (AST) sets home page dashboards for individual users or groups. A is incorrect — Data Entry 123 simplifies forms. C is incorrect — Standard Application Reports generates operational reports. D is incorrect — HelpDesk manages support tickets.

question: Which dashboard component allows end users to display a PDF within a dashboard?

options.A: Data Explorer

explanation: C is correct: File Viewer displays various file formats including PDFs within a dashboard. A is incorrect — Data Explorer shows non-cube tabular data. B is incorrect — Book Viewer displays OneStream Report Books, not standalone PDFs. D is incorrect — Image displays image files, not PDFs.

question: In which property would a user define the look and feel of a button in OneStream?

options.A: Text

explanation: B is correct: Display Format defines visual styling properties like MarginLeft, TextColor, Width, Height for buttons and other components. A is incorrect — Text defines the button label text. C is incorrect — Description defines the end-user display title. D is incorrect — Tool Tip shows hover text.

question: What is the purpose of a wireframe in dashboard design?

options.A: To test all data adapters needed within a dashboard.
options.B: To serve as a formal blueprint that outlines the layout and structure of the dashboard.
options.C: To customize nodes within the maintenance unit.
options.D: To set a dashboard as a user's home page.

explanation: B is correct: a wireframe is a formal blueprint outlining layout and component placement before development begins. A is incorrect — data adapter testing is done post-build. C is incorrect — customizing maintenance unit nodes is a configuration task. D is incorrect — home pages are set through AST or application settings.

question: Which type of parameter can be used for applying formatting to dashboard components?

options.A: Bound List parameter

explanation: D is correct: Literal Value parameters apply and standardize formatting to dashboard components. A is incorrect — Bound List generates member lists via SQL or method queries. B is incorrect — Delimited List provides predefined selectable values. C is incorrect — Member List creates flat lists of dimension members.

question: How would a user configure a button to open a dialog displaying a specific dashboard?

options.A: Set Selection Changed POV Action to Change POV > Add the dashboard name to the Dashboard to Open in Dialog property.
options.B: Set Selection Changed User Interface Action to Open Dialog > Add the dashboard name to the Dashboards to Redraw property.
options.C: Set Selection Changed User Interface Action to Refresh > Add the dashboard name to the Dashboards to Redraw property.
options.D: Set Selection Changed Interface Action to Open Dialog > Add the dashboard name to the Dashboard to Open in Dialog property.

explanation: D is correct: set Selection Changed Interface Action to Open Dialog and add the target dashboard name to the Dashboard to Open in Dialog property. A is incorrect — Change POV updates POV context. B is incorrect — Dashboards to Redraw is for Refresh/Redraw, not Open Dialog. C is incorrect — Refresh updates data, not opens a dialog.

question: What is the purpose of the design mode in OneStream dashboards?

options.A: To create Business Intelligence visualizations of data from data adapters.
options.B: To pinpoint specific dashboard components and easily locate them in the maintenance unit.
options.C: To edit business rules related to the dashboard.
options.D: To create a wireframe of a dashboard before building it in OneStream.

explanation: B is correct: design mode identifies specific components within a running dashboard and navigates to their location in the maintenance unit tree for customization. A is incorrect — BI visualizations are created in the BI Designer. C is incorrect — business rules are edited through the Business Rules node. D is incorrect — wireframing is done outside OneStream.

question: How can a user configure a button to refresh the Cube View data on a dashboard?

options.A: Set Selection Changed User Interface Action to Refresh > Add the dashboard name to the Dashboards to Redraw property.
options.B: Set Selection Changed Interface Action to Open Dialog > Add the dashboard name to the Dashboard to Open in Dialog property.
options.C: Set Selection Changed POV Action to Change POV > Apply the dashboard name to the Dashboard to Open in Dialog property.
options.D: Set Selection Changed User Interface Action to Redraw > Add the dashboard name to the Dashboards to Redraw property.

explanation: A is correct: Refresh action + Dashboards to Redraw property triggers a new database connection for current data. B is incorrect — Open Dialog opens a dashboard in a dialog, not refreshes data. C is incorrect — Change POV updates the POV context. D is incorrect — Redraw redraws visually without a new database connection.

question: A user needs a flat list of dimension members from the Dimension Library for end users to select in a combo box. Which parameter type should they use?

options.A: Input Value

explanation: D is correct: Member List parameters present a flat list of dimension members (from the Member Filter Builder) for combo box selection. A is incorrect — Input Value provides a text entry field. B is incorrect — Bound List generates lists via SQL or method queries. C is incorrect — Literal Value hard-codes a formatting value.

question: Where can a user access business rules within a maintenance unit?

options.A: Components node

explanation: B is correct: business rules are accessed through the Business Rules node in the maintenance unit tree. A is incorrect — Components holds dashboard components. C is incorrect — Data Adapters holds data adapters. D is incorrect — Strings holds localization strings.

question: Which property would an administrator use to assign a Member List parameter to a combo box component?

options.A: Bound Parameter

explanation: A is correct: the Bound Parameter property connects a Member List parameter to a combo box by entering the parameter name. B is incorrect — Template Parameter Values passes runtime values to template parameters. C is incorrect — Text is the combo box label. D is incorrect — Display Format controls visual styling.

question: Which Image File Source Type should be used in a button to display a JPEG image stored in the Files node of a maintenance unit?

options.A: File Share File

explanation: D is correct: Workspace File references images uploaded to the Files node within a maintenance unit. A is incorrect — File Share File is for network shares. B is incorrect — System Database File is not a standard OneStream source type. C is incorrect — URL is for external website images.

question: Which component type would a user use to display a PDF user guide within a dashboard?

options.A: Filter Editor

explanation: B is correct: File Viewer displays various file formats including PDFs within a dashboard. A is incorrect — Filter Editor builds filters. C is incorrect — Image displays image files, not PDFs. D is incorrect — Data Explorer Report displays non-cube tabular data.

question: What does the 0_Frame prefix in a dashboard name indicate?

options.A: It denotes dashboards in a testing phase.
options.B: It means the dashboard is a template from which others are derived.
options.C: It indicates that this dashboard acts as the main or parent container dashboard within its group.
options.D: It indicates the dashboard is only visible to administrators.

explanation: C is correct: 0_Frame is the main container dashboard that embeds all other sub-dashboards and is the one deployed to end users. A is incorrect — testing dashboards are kept in separate Workspaces. B is incorrect — 0_Frame is not a template; it is the primary launcher. D is incorrect — it is the end-user-facing dashboard.

question: How does a user preview a dashboard in design mode?

options.A: Right-click the dashboard > Click View Dashboard In Design Mode.
options.B: Select the dashboard > Click Set Selected Dashboard As Default, then View Dashboard In Design Mode.
options.C: Select the dashboard > Click View Dashboard In Design Mode directly.
options.D: Select the dashboard > Click Preview Dashboard, then View Dashboard In Design Mode.

explanation: B is correct: select the dashboard, click Set Selected Dashboard As Default, then click View Dashboard In Design Mode. A is incorrect — right-clicking alone doesn't work without setting default first. C is incorrect — View Dashboard In Design Mode requires setting as default first. D is incorrect — there is no Preview Dashboard button in this workflow.

question: What occurs when a user selects a red triangle next to a component in a dashboard while in design mode?

options.A: It deletes the component from the dashboard.
options.B: It toggles the visibility of the component.
options.C: It navigates directly to where the component sits within the maintenance unit tree.

explanation: C is correct: the red triangle navigates directly to the component's location in the maintenance unit tree for easy editing. A is incorrect — deletion is done from the maintenance unit. B is incorrect — visibility toggling is not the red triangle's function. D is incorrect — duplicating is a separate action.

question: Which dashboard layout type is commonly used to embed a toolbar across the top of a 0_Frame dashboard?

options.A: Vertical Stack Panel

explanation: C is correct: Horizontal Stack Panel organizes components horizontally — the recommended layout for horizontal header toolbars. A is incorrect — Vertical Stack Panel is for vertical alignment. B is incorrect — Tabs show one component at a time. D is incorrect — Wrap places components sequentially with auto line breaks.

question: When linking two Cube Views so one refreshes based on cell selections in the other, where in the source Cube View are Bound Parameters created?

options.A: Common slider

explanation: C is correct: Bound Parameter Names are set up in the Navigation Links properties of the source Cube View. A is incorrect — Common slider applies settings across rows and columns. B is incorrect — Sharing manages Column Sharing. D is incorrect — Report slider controls header and footer settings.

question: What is the Shared Workspace Names property used for within an Application Workspace?

options.A: To add a list of maintenance units to use assets from.
options.B: To add a list of components from other Workspaces.
options.C: To add a list of data adapters shared across Workspaces.
options.D: To add a comma-delimited list of Workspaces that it can use assets from.

explanation: D is correct: Shared Workspace Names is a comma-delimited list of other Workspaces whose assets the current Workspace can use. A is incorrect — Workspace names are listed, not maintenance unit names. B is incorrect — individual component names are not added. C is incorrect — data adapter names are not added separately.

question: An administrator in Workspace B wants to reuse a dashboard from Workspace A. How can they do it?

options.A: In Workspace B, set Is Shareable Workspace to True and reference Workspace A in Shared Workspace Name.
options.B: In Workspace B, set Is Shareable Workspace to True and in Workspace A, reference Workspace B in Shared Workspace Name.
options.C: In Workspace A, set Is Shareable Workspace to True and in Workspace B, reference Workspace A in Shared Workspace Name.
options.D: In both Workspaces A and B, set Is Shareable Workspace to True.

explanation: C is correct: Workspace A (the source) must have Is Shareable Workspace = True, and Workspace B (the consumer) must reference Workspace A in Shared Workspace Names. A is incorrect — the source Workspace A, not the consumer B, needs to be set as shareable. B is incorrect — the roles are reversed. D is incorrect — only the source needs Is Shareable set to True.

question: An administrator wants end users to be able to multi-select entities in a combo box. Where is the multiple selection setting located?

options.A: Within the Template Parameter Values property (IsMultiSelect = True).
options.B: Within the Bound Parameter property (IsMultiSelect = True).
options.D: Within the Display Format properties (IsMultiSelect = True).

explanation: D is correct: IsMultiSelect = True is configured within the Display Format properties of the combo box component. A is incorrect — Template Parameter Values passes runtime parameter values. B is incorrect — Bound Parameter connects a parameter to the combo box. C is incorrect — Text defines the label text.

question: What organizational unit sits at the top of the structure for creating dashboards in OneStream?

options.A: Dashboard groups

explanation: D is correct: Workspaces sit at the very top of the hierarchy: Workspace > Maintenance Unit > Dashboard Group > Dashboard. A is incorrect — dashboard groups are two levels below Workspaces. B is incorrect — maintenance units are one level below Workspaces. C is incorrect — Assemblies are a technical Workspace component, not the top-level organizer.
